review: Help diagnostics full boundary independent original review
verdict: ORIGINAL ADVERSE: three P2 lifecycle defects and one P3 specified display gap reproduced on initial captured bytes. Owner repairs changed six inputs before report serialization; revised bytes have not been re-reviewed. No native/package qualification.

findings.title: Cover leaves previously offered error identities active after resume
findings.cause: cover closes the dialog, but WeakMap-held offered buttons and their identity closures remain connected. Click admission checks availability only, which becomes true on resume.

steps: Open it; call cover; confirm dialog removed
Resume; dispatch click on retained original error button

findings.impact: Lock or project-transition retirement does not clear contextual entry points. The previous diagnosis can reopen after admission resumes.
findings.requiredRepair: Retire offered buttons and identities on cover/disposal with bounded tracking or generation guards; retain cover -> resume -> old-button regression.

findings.title: A save started before cover can offer fresh stale context after resume
findings.cause: saveCurrent checks disposed and owner identity after await, but does not capture the Help lifecycle generation. If the same draft resumes, the delayed result can call explain in the new context. Diagram save also lacks a captured Help generation.

steps: Extract exact saveCurrent from docs.js into SAME browser VM realm as real resolver and workspace helper
Pause and cover; resume and unpause before delivering result
Deliver {ok:false,code: DOCUMENT_CONFLICT}; click newly offered button
ownProbe.fixtureCorrection: Initial separate-realm scratch attempt resolved to generic unknown; the reported exact diagnosis is from the corrected same-realm probe.

findings.impact: Removing existing offers alone is insufficient: a retired in-flight operation can create new stale context after admission resumes.
findings.requiredRepair: Capture Help context generation before relevant async operations and require it to remain current before offering a result. Retain an adapter-level delayed-save regression.

findings.title: A delayed close event from a retired dialog closes its replacement
findings.cause: close/cancel/keydown listeners call shared close without checking which dialog instance raised the event. close always closes the current global dialog.

steps: Model deferred close delivery in existing finite Element fixture: close marks old element closed and queues its event
Open first dialog; close it; open new source-import dialog
ownProbe.evidenceClass: Adversarial DOM event-scheduling model, not actual browser/Electron observation.

findings.impact: A retired asynchronous lifecycle callback can dismiss a newly opened manual. Existing synchronous close-event fixture misses this.
findings.requiredRepair: Bind lifecycle callbacks to their owned current dialog instance/generation and ignore retired instances. Retain deferred-close-event regression.

findings.title: Unknown explanations discard original bounded code
findings.cause: open renders only the generic unknown banner; contextual adapter also discards identity when resolution is unknown.

findings.impact: Specified bounded original error code is unavailable for identifying/reporting unknown receipts. Generic cause remains honest.
